<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Initiate an anchor request"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/applicationLedger/anchor"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Initiates an anchoring request for an application. This endpoint is used to create an anchor request without explicit wallet approval. The wallet is resolved from the application (application -&gt; organization -&gt; wallet).
